message:
Now let me look at the `p2p_add_device` function and how it handles the group info parsing, which is where the vulnerability is. The description says "parsing and copying of the WPS secondary device types list in P2P group client fails to validate the length of the contents when handling P2P group information, which encodes this data in a different attribute."

Let me look at `p2p_add_device` in p2p.c:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "p2p_add_device" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hostap/src/p2p/p2p.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
